name: Question 17
problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=-5 \\ 5{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
Notice that the system is already organized so that the variables are in the order ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient.   

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 \\ 5 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations:

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -5 \\ 5 & 3 & -3\end{aligned}]
$$
